program:
"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)
      python3 playlist_demo.py play    (simulates playing it in order)
"""
import json, sys, time

PL = {'title': 'Playlist of the Week — Week 1: Ambient Vocal', 'theme': 'Ambient Vocal', 'week': 'W1', 'items': [{'n': 1, 'title': 'Breathing soft machine', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 2, 'title': 'Breathing ocean hum', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 3, 'title': 'Breathing slow breath', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 4, 'title': 'Quiet cathedral reverb', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 5, 'title': 'Cloud chamber Sleep', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 6, 'title': 'Breathing cloud chamber', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 7, 'title': 'The deep sleep Hum', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 8, 'title': 'Breathing deep sleep', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 9, 'title': 'Breathing slow breath', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 10, 'title': 'Quiet cathedral reverb', 'detail': 'Signature original'}], 'curator_notes': 'Week 1 (Ambient Vocal): open with track 1 to lift the room, ride the midweek energy through tracks 4–7, and land soft with track 10. Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))
    print("\n--- curator notes ---\n" + PL["curator_notes"])

def play():
    render()
    print("\n▶ now playing (simulated order):")
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("  ♪ %s ..." % it["title"])
        time.sleep(0.15)
    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    (play if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "play" else render)()

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.

Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)
      python3 playlist_demo.py play    (simulates playing it in order)
"""
import json, sys, time

PL = {'title': 'Playlist of the Week — Week 5: Country Ballads', 'theme': 'Country Ballads', 'week': 'W5', 'items': [{'n': 1, 'title': "Dancin' with rainy windshield", 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 2, 'title': 'The goodbye kiss I Knew', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 3, 'title': 'The goodbye kiss I Knew', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 4, 'title': "Dancin' with goodbye kiss", 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 5, 'title': 'The empty barstool Road Home', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 6, 'title': 'Old love letter Heart', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 7, 'title': 'Old love letter Heart', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 8, 'title': 'The goodbye kiss Road Home', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 9, 'title': "Dancin' with front porch", 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 10, 'title': 'The old love letter I Knew', 'detail': 'Signature original'}], 'curator_notes': 'Week 5 (Country Ballads): open with track 1 to lift the room, ride the midweek energy through tracks 4–7, and land soft with track 10. Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))

def play():

    for it in PL["items"]:

        time.sleep(0.15)
    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":

Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():

Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)

Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))
    print("\n--- curator notes ---\n" + PL["curator_notes"])

def play():

    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)

import json, sys, time

Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())

    for it in PL["items"]:

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.

Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)

program:
"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)
      python3 playlist_demo.py play    (simulates playing it in order)
"""
import json, sys, time

PL = {'title': 'Playlist of the Week — Week 16: Novelty Songs', 'theme': 'Novelty Songs', 'week': 'W16', 'items': [{'n': 1, 'title': 'Silly pie in face', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 2, 'title': 'Do the talking dog', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 3, 'title': 'My purple people Song', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 4, 'title': 'Silly banana phone', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 5, 'title': 'The purple people Twist', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 6, 'title': 'The banana phone Twist', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 7, 'title': 'Silly disco duck', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 8, 'title': 'The purple people Twist', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 9, 'title': 'Disco duck Mania', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 10, 'title': 'My purple people Song', 'detail': 'Signature original'}], 'curator_notes': 'Week 16 (Novelty Songs): open with track 1 to lift the room, ride the midweek energy through tracks 4–7, and land soft with track 10. Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))
    print("\n--- curator notes ---\n" + PL["curator_notes"])

def play():
    render()
    print("\n▶ now playing (simulated order):")
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("  ♪ %s ..." % it["title"])
        time.sleep(0.15)
    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    (play if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "play" else render)()

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)
      python3 playlist_demo.py play    (simulates playing it in order)
"""
import json, sys, time

PL = {'title': 'Playlist of the Week — Week 17: Pop Hits', 'theme': 'Pop Hits', 'week': 'W17', 'items': [{'n': 1, 'title': 'Electric midnight drive', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 2, 'title': 'Dance with text me', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 3, 'title': 'City lights Star', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 4, 'title': 'City lights Tonight', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 5, 'title': 'City lights Star', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 6, 'title': 'Neon dream Star', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 7, 'title': 'La La neon dream', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 8, 'title': 'Neon dream Tonight', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 9, 'title': 'Text me Tonight', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 10, 'title': 'La La summer fling', 'detail': 'Signature original'}], 'curator_notes': 'Week 17 (Pop Hits): open with track 1 to lift the room, ride the midweek energy through tracks 4–7, and land soft with track 10. Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))
    print("\n--- curator notes ---\n" + PL["curator_notes"])

def play():
    render()
    print("\n▶ now playing (simulated order):")
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("  ♪ %s ..." % it["title"])
        time.sleep(0.15)
    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    (play if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "play" else render)()

def render():

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)
      python3 playlist_demo.py play    (simulates playing it in order)
"""
import json, sys, time

PL = {'title': 'Playlist of the Week — Week 19: Punk Rock', 'theme': 'Punk Rock', 'week': 'W19', 'items': [{'n': 1, 'title': 'Three Chords anarchy sign', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 2, 'title': 'Three-chord riot Riot Grrrl', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 3, 'title': 'Oi! leather jacket!', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 4, 'title': 'DIY flyer Forever', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 5, 'title': 'Three-chord riot Forever', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 6, 'title': 'Anarchy sign Kids', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 7, 'title': 'Oi! leather jacket!', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 8, 'title': 'Leather jacket Kids', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 9, 'title': 'Oi! underground club!', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 10, 'title': 'Safety pin Riot Grrrl', 'detail': 'Signature original'}], 'curator_notes': 'Week 19 (Punk Rock): open with track 1 to lift the room, ride the midweek energy through tracks 4–7, and land soft with track 10. Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))
    print("\n--- curator notes ---\n" + PL["curator_notes"])

def play():
    render()
    print("\n▶ now playing (simulated order):")
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("  ♪ %s ..." % it["title"])
        time.sleep(0.15)
    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Working demo for this playlist record: renderer + play-order simulator.
Run:  python3 playlist_demo.py          (prints the full playlist document)
      python3 playlist_demo.py play    (simulates playing it in order)
"""
import json, sys, time

PL = {'title': 'Playlist of the Week — Week 20: Roots Reggae', 'theme': 'Roots Reggae', 'week': 'W20', 'items': [{'n': 1, 'title': 'The babylon system Beat', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 2, 'title': 'Island ghetto youth', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 3, 'title': 'One ital food', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 4, 'title': 'One zion train', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 5, 'title': 'One dreadlocks', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 6, 'title': 'One babylon system', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 7, 'title': "Zion train Jammin'", 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 8, 'title': 'Irie freedom road', 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 9, 'title': "Rasta lion Jammin'", 'detail': 'Signature original'}, {'n': 10, 'title': "Rasta lion Jammin'", 'detail': 'Signature original'}], 'curator_notes': 'Week 20 (Roots Reggae): open with track 1 to lift the room, ride the midweek energy through tracks 4–7, and land soft with track 10. Every song is complete and publication-ready — no stubs, no placeholders.'}

def render():
    print("=" * 64)
    print(PL["title"].upper())
    print(PL["theme"])
    print("=" * 64)
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("%2d. %s — %s" % (it["n"], it["title"], it["detail"]))
    print("\n--- curator notes ---\n" + PL["curator_notes"])

def play():
    render()
    print("\n▶ now playing (simulated order):")
    for it in PL["items"]:
        print("  ♪ %s ..." % it["title"])
        time.sleep(0.15)
    print("■ end of playlist — %d items" % len(PL["items"]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    (play if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "play" else render)()
